mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 77 degrees, feeling like 79. If you are heading out tonight, look to the West over Mount Horeb at 8:21 PM to catch a glimpse of the International Space Station as it travels toward the Northeast near the Home Depot in Madison, reaching about halfway up the sky during its six-minute pass.

In city news, the Verona Police Department has reported that a 19-year-old Madison resident was taken into custody following a burglary in progress on September 10th in the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way. Additionally, residents are reminded that election notices for the November 2026 General Election have been posted.

It is a busy few days in the area. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, Verona will host the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival on Main Street, and this coming week features trivia nights at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's.
On September 10th, officers responded to a burglary in the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way. A suspect was located and taken into custody after a handgun and shell casing were recovered from the scene.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew. The restaurant is currently open and will remain so until their closing time of 10:30 PM tonight.
